$comment: JNPA operating container terminals. CONFIRM current operators with JNPA before live cutover (Corrigendum 3). Geometry = approximate berth-line centroids at JNPT, EPSG:4326 [lng, lat]; replace with surveyed polygons from the JNPA WebMap before production. Siding mapping T1/T2 and TOS access mode are config-driven on purpose (prompt §3, §6).

terminals.name: Nhava Sheva India Gateway Terminal
terminals.$geomNote: Terminal-marker position only (2D marker + 2D gates + hidden 3D deck derive from this; 3D asset placements in data/positions.json are absolute and unaffected). Fine-tuned to the JNPA satellite reference: NSIGT is the NE-most (and northern-most) container berth.

terminals.name: Bharat Mumbai Container Terminals
terminals.$geomNote: BMCT sits SW of the older NSICT/NSIGT/GTI cluster — this separation is the raison d'être of ITRHO (inter-terminal road transfer). Geom aligned to BMCT's 3D asset placements (data/positions.json: vessel/cranes/yards/gates) so the berth-line sits on the developed terminal instead of in open water; the previous [72.9120, 18.9100] fell in the channel. Approximate for demonstration; replace with surveyed polygon before production.

terminals.name: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Container Terminal
terminals.operator: JNPA / J M Baxi (operator transition — CONFIRM)
terminals.$geomNote: Terminal-marker position only (2D marker + 2D gates + hidden 3D deck derive from this; 3D asset placements in data/positions.json are absolute and unaffected). Fine-tuned to the JNPA satellite reference: NSFT/JNPCT is third along the wharf, between GTI and NSICT.

railSidings.name: BMCT Rail Yard Siding T2
railSidings.$geomNote: T2 sits at the BMCT rail yard on the developed BMCT terminal (landward of BMCT's berth [72.9383,18.9386], toward its gates [~72.9435,18.9377]). Previously [72.9145,18.9130] — the OLD in-channel BMCT position that was never updated when BMCT's berth geom was corrected onto land, so the marker fell in open water. The ~5.5 km T1↔T2 gap is what ITT trailers shuttle across under ITRHO.
